page.content:
Rabia Chaudry's later podcast that kept investigating Adnan's case.

How Undisclosed connects

  • Character: Rabia Chaudry — Rabia Chaudry launched Undisclosed after Serial.
  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Undisclosed followed Season 1 as a second investigation of Adnan's case.
  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Season 1's audience and loose ends inspired Undisclosed.

What is Undisclosed?

Undisclosed is the podcast Rabia Chaudry launched after Serial, a more advocacy-minded second look at Adnan Syed and then other cases, born directly from Season 1's audience.

Key threads lead to Rabia Chaudry, Serial Season 1 and Serial Season 1.
